title: 11 High-Value Discovery Meetings for a Wealth Management Firm
challenge: A wealth management business wanted to strengthen its visibility with affluent professionals and business owners. Trust was essential, but its digital presence was limited.
solution: Myntmore built an advisor-led LinkedIn positioning strategy focused on wealth planning, financial decision-making and long-term investment discipline. Targeted networking prioritised relevant professional communities.
results: Stronger professional engagement among target audiences.
